candidates.prompt:

Theme: questioning the assumptions behind Mahjong expected value calculators, for the first part of an article series.
Design: bold Japanese editorial typography, deep mahjong table green and nearly black background, strong warm yellow accent, very subtle abstract statistical grid and chart traces. Main title on the left-center in two lines, white with 「期待値」 highlighted warm yellow. Keep all meaningful content within generous 10% margins and the central 70% height so cover crops preserve the title.

信じていい？」

Constraints: absolutely no mahjong tiles, no tile faces, no tile-like rectangles, no characters, no robots, no brand logos, no NAGA/pystyle logos, no watermark, no fabricated statistics. Subtle decorative chart elements only, without numerical labels. Do not put a variant number or mockup frame in the artwork.
